item.title: Central Bank Of Bahrain Holds Overnight Interest Rate At 4.25%
item.description: The Central Bank of Bahrain (CBB) has opted to maintain its overnight deposit interest rate at 4.25%, signaling a steady monetary stance amid ongoing shifts in global financial conditions. The decision reflects the central bank’s continued focus on preserving monetary stability and safeguarding the resilience of Bahrain’s financial system. item.title: Bahrain: MPs Urge 24-Hour Cancer A&E Wing At King Hamad University Hospital
item.description: A group of MPs has filed an urgent proposal calling for a dedicated emergency wing for oncology patients at King Hamad University Hospital, operating 24 hours a day. item.title: Bahrain: Mail Parcel Of Marijuana’ Lands Three Asians In Court
item.description: The First High Criminal Court in Bahrain has begun hearing the case of three Asian men accused of receiving a mail parcel from the United States containing 560.27 grams of marijuana hidden among clothing. The public prosecution charged the first and second defendants with importing and selling marijuana for trafficking purposes, while the third defendant was charged with possession and intent to distribute the drug without legal authorization.

item.title: Bahrain: Woman Hurt In Rear-End Crash Awarded BD9,000
item.description: A woman who suffered a head injury in a rear-end crash has won BD9,000 dinars in damages after a civil court ruled that the driver at fault and his insurer must pay up. The High Civil Court also held the pair jointly liable for court costs, a contribution towards her legal fees, and 90 dinars to cover the medical committee’s fees. item.title: Bahrain: Lawyer Ordered To Pay BD1,000 To MP Over Social Media Defamation
item.description: A court has ordered a lawyer to pay BD1,000 to a sitting MP after finding he defamed him in an Instagram video. The High Civil Court said the sum was compensation for moral harm. It also ordered the lawyer to pay court costs and BD100 in lawyers’ fees. item.title: Bahrain: IQ And Behaviour Checks Required For Public School Inclusion Programme
item.description: An IQ score between 50 and 75, an age range of six to 15, and no history of severe behavioural or emotional problems are among the requirements the Education Ministry says it uses before a child is placed in its public school inclusion programme. item.title: Bahrain Court Overturns Three-Year Sentence Of Woman For Lack Of Evidence In ‘Trafficking’ Domestic Worker
item.description: Bahrain’s First High Criminal Court has overturned a previous ruling sentencing a Bahraini woman to three years in prison and acquitted her of human trafficking charges involving a domestic worker. item.title: Dubai Gold Price Plunges Dh35 From Record High After 5% Drop Worldwide
item.description: Dubai gold prices fell sharply minutes after hitting fresh records, mirroring a sudden downturn in global markets. In the UAE, rates dropped from Dh665 to Dh629 per gram, a Dh35 slide that tracked a rapid pullback in international prices. It closed at Dh639 yesterday. Global gold tumbled more than 5% after reaching $5,000 an ounce for the first time, as traders reassessed the rally that had pushed the metal to repeated all-time highs.
